The resulting request is: > > https://rest.bandsintown.com/artists/Windhand/events?date=upcoming > > and the tour listing fails. > > I isolated this rule specifically in uBlock Origin 1.74.0 on Firefox 155: > > - With AdGuard/uBO – URL Tracking Protection enabled, the listing is broken. > - Disabling that filter list makes the listing work. > - Re-enabling the list and adding this local exception also makes the listing work: > > ||bandsintown.com^$removeparam=app_id,badfilter > > - Removing that local exception makes the listing fail again. > - The issue persists without custom filters/rules and with other browser extensions disabled. > > The uBlock Origin/uAssets maintainers directed me to report this to AdGuard because the offending rule comes from the AdGuard-maintained filter list. > > Related uAssets report: https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/issues/34546 > > This indicates that `app_id` is functionally required by this Squarespace/Bandsintown integration and removing it from this request breaks the tour listing. ### Screenshots
